info.title: Redress API
info.description: Interactive contract for the production Redress API. Use Authorize to test protected endpoints with a Bearer access token.

get.summary: Stream an opaque, short-lived media URL
get.description: The URL is an encrypted bearer capability that expires after at most 15 minutes. The API streams the private image from object storage without returning an S3 URL or object key. Keep the URL private.

post.description: Only purpose=bodyPhoto is supported by this endpoint. The returned URL is an owner-only, short-lived URL and must be attached with PATCH /body-profiles/{id}.

file.description: JPEG, PNG, or WebP; max 8 MB.

get.summary: List the current shopper's body profiles

post.description: The first profile must be relation=self. Height and weight are required. Creating a duplicate self profile returns 409 with details.reason=self_exists.

put.summary: Create or update the shopper's self body profile safely
put.description: Idempotent onboarding helper. It has the same fields as profile creation except relation is always self.

patch.summary: Update a body profile, its measurements, or photo angles
patch.description: Measurement and photo objects merge by field. Set a photo angle to null to delete that private stored file. A non-self profile may change relation between partner, child, and other. Changing a profile into or out of self returns 422 with details.fields.relation=immutable.

delete.summary: Delete an owned partner, child, or other body profile
delete.description: Requires the authenticated shopper to own the profile. Self profiles cannot be deleted; at least one profile must remain. Attached profile photos are deleted with the profile. Success returns data=null.

post.summary: Request a measurement estimate from stored body-profile photos
post.description: Reserved for the body-profile editor. It currently returns 503 until an approved estimator is configured.
Idempotent. Saving the self profile later clears the skipped state.

post.summary: Estimate measurements from two temporary full-body photos
post.description: The front and side images are decoded in memory only. They are never stored, queued, logged, or added as media. Until an approved estimator is configured this endpoint returns 503 and the app must offer manual entry.

get.summary: Get the current privacy policy and its consent version

post.summary: Log in with a verified email and password
post.description: Native clients receive access and refresh tokens in JSON. Browser clients receive the refresh token in an HttpOnly cookie and it is omitted from JSON.

patch.description: Email, phone, displayName and photoUrl cannot be changed here. displayName is derived from firstName and lastName. Use the dedicated verified-contact and photo endpoints.

post.summary: Accept the current privacy policy for an authenticated account
post.description: Use for pre-existing accounts with no consent or a stale consent version. Calling it when consent is already current is idempotent.

put.summary: Upload or replace the current user's profile photo
put.description: Flutter and Postman must send the photo as the `image` file in multipart/form-data. JPEG, PNG and WebP are validated from their decoded bytes, stripped of metadata, converted to WebP, encrypted at rest in private S3, and returned through a short-lived signed photoUrl. Maximum image size is 8 MiB. Legacy raw-image handling remains an internal compatibility path only.

delete.summary: Remove the current user's profile photo

post.summary: Send a verification code to a new email address
post.description: Requires a recently authenticated session. The existing verified email remains active until verification succeeds.

post.summary: Verify and apply the new email address
post.description: The OTP is bound to the authenticated account. On success, every other session is revoked.

post.summary: Send a verification code to a new E.164 phone number
post.description: Requires a recently authenticated session. The existing verified phone remains active until verification succeeds.

post.summary: Verify and apply the new phone number
post.description: The OTP is bound to the authenticated account. On success, every other session is revoked.

post.summary: Verify the first phone number for an authenticated account
post.description: Backward-compatible phone-link endpoint. Request its OTP through POST /auth/otp/send with purpose phone_link while authenticated.

post.summary: Send an authentication or phone-link OTP
post.description: Set purpose to phone_link only after authorizing with a recently authenticated Bearer token.

post.summary: Verify an OTP and continue authentication
Create an account from a verified signup token
post.description: New Flutter builds send X-App-Contract: signup-consent. With that header, consent is required and Google signup is deferred until this endpoint. Legacy clients retain the existing behavior without the header.

post.summary: Authenticate with a Google ID token
post.description: With X-App-Contract: signup-consent, a new Google identity returns signup_required and no account is created until POST /auth/signup records privacy consent.
Native clients send refreshToken in the request body. Browser clients use their HttpOnly cookie.

post.summary: End every session for the current account
Set a new password using a reset token
Set the first password for the current account
Create or resume an anonymous guest session
post.description: Native clients must send installationId and platform. To resume a native session, include its previous token in X-Guest-Token.

get.summary: Check whether the API process is alive
Get the public, server-curated Home feed
get.description: Returns the Flutter Home feed contract: live CMS banners, lookbook, featured brands and offers; active Women/Men/Kids root categories; public product cards for AI picks and discounted deals; and stable empty rails for unsupported try-on and popularity data. Unpublished CMS sections are empty. Media URLs are short-lived server-proxied URLs.

500.description: Home feed could not be retrieved

get.description: Requires platform.home_content.view. Draft, scheduled, live, expired and archived records are returned only to authorized platform administrators.

post.description: Requires platform.home_content.create. This always creates a draft; call the publish endpoint explicitly after preview and validation.

patch.summary: Update a draft or live Home placement
patch.description: Requires platform.home_content.update. Send multipart/form-data even when only text fields change; image is optional. A live placement is revalidated before it remains live.

delete.summary: Soft-delete an archived or draft Home placement

409.description: Live placement must first be archived

post.summary: Publish or schedule a Home placement
post.description: Requires platform.home_content.publish. The current image, locale content, destination and schedule are revalidated. A future startsAt becomes Scheduled automatically.
Requires platform.home_content.publish. Archived content is immediately excluded from the public Home feed.

get.description: Requires platform.categories.view. Use parentId=0 to return root categories only.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Matches code, slug, English name, or Italian name.

parameters.name: parentId
parameters.description: A parent category ID, or 0 for root categories.

post.description: Requires platform.categories.create. English and Italian names are both required.

409.description: Code or slug is already in use

patch.description: Requires platform.categories.update. A category cannot be moved beneath itself or a descendant, and a parent must be active when the resulting category is active.

409.description: Duplicate identity or category hierarchy conflict

delete.summary: Soft-delete a category that is not in use
delete.description: Requires platform.categories.delete. Deletion is rejected when the category has child categories, products, Home placements, attributes, or measurement requirements.

post.summary: Create a brand and optionally upload its logo
post.description: Requires platform.brands.create. JSON requests create without a logo; use multipart/form-data with the `logo` field to upload one.

patch.summary: Update a brand or replace its logo
patch.description: Requires platform.brands.update. A multipart request containing only `logo` is valid.

delete.description: Requires platform.brands.delete. Deletion is blocked when products or Home placements still use the brand.

post.description: The selected data type, input type, unit, and multiple-value settings must be compatible.
Values can be created only for option attributes.

post.summary: Assign an attribute to a category
post.description: An active mapping requires active category and attribute records. Variant attributes must be single-select options.

get.summary: List products in the selected vendor workspace
get.description: Requires vendor.products.view. Send X-Vendor-Id when the account belongs to more than one vendor.

get.summary: Get one vendor product including draft relations

patch.description: Submitted products are locked until approval or rejection. Editing an unpublished approved draft resets it to an approval draft.

get.summary: Get category-wise size-chart requirements and variant measurements

put.summary: Create or replace a variant size chart
put.description: Measurement types must be enabled by one of the product's active categories. Required measurements are checked when submitting for approval.

get.summary: Get category attribute definitions and current values
get.description: Returns product-level and variant-level attribute scopes together with current values.

put.description: Only attributes mapped to the product categories as product-level attributes are accepted. The request replaces the complete product-level attribute set.
Only attributes marked as variant attributes for a selected category are accepted. The request replaces the complete variant-level attribute set.

post.summary: Upload up to ten product images
post.description: Uses multipart/form-data. Send image binaries in the images field; optional metadata applies to the entire upload batch.

post.summary: Submit a complete draft for admin approval
post.description: Requires at least one category, localized product name, active variant, and product image.

get.summary: Review a product and all approval data

post.description: Approves all pending product images at the same time.

get.description: Filter by approval and operational status. Requires platform.vendors.view.

get.summary: View vendor onboarding and owner details

post.description: Approval does not activate the vendor. Activate it separately when operational checks are complete.

patch.summary: Activate, deactivate, or suspend a vendor
patch.description: Only an approved vendor can become active. Suspending immediately removes the vendor's products from public catalog results.

post.description: Optional logo must be supplied as the logo field in multipart/form-data.

patch.description: Updating a rejected application clears its rejection reason and resubmits it for review.

patch.summary: Activate or deactivate a vendor staff member

get.description: Public endpoint. Private brand logo objects are returned as short-lived signed URLs.

get.summary: List active categories as a localized tree
Get catalog filter metadata in one bootstrap response
get.description: Returns active brands, categories, colors, size systems, fit profiles, and filterable attributes.

Only published, approved, public products from active approved vendors are returned. Selecting a parent category includes its active descendants. Repeated or comma-separated brand, color, size, and fit filters are accepted.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Localized product name, brand name, or exact/partial product code search.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size IDs from /catalog/filters, repeated or comma-separated.

get.summary: Get a public product with variants and fit data
get.description: Returns approved media, active variants, availability, localized attributes, and garment measurements. Draft, hidden, unapproved, and inactive-vendor products return the same not-found response.

get.summary: Get an account or guest shopping bag
get.description: Use Authorization: Bearer for an account cart. Native guests send X-Guest-Token; web guests send their HttpOnly guest cookie.

post.summary: Merge a guest shopping bag into the authenticated account
post.description: Call immediately after login, before any authenticated cart request. Requires Authorization: Bearer. Native clients must also send X-Guest-Token; web clients send the HttpOnly guest cookie with credentials included. No request body is accepted. The operation is retry-safe for the same account.

parameters.name: X-Guest-Token
parameters.description: Required for native clients. Web clients use the HttpOnly guest cookie.

post.summary: Add a selected product variant to an account or guest bag
post.description: Native guests authenticate with X-Guest-Token; web guests use their HttpOnly guest cookie.

patch.summary: Update a bag item quantity; zero removes it
patch.description: Native guests authenticate with X-Guest-Token; web guests use their HttpOnly guest cookie.

delete.description: Native guests authenticate with X-Guest-Token; web guests use their HttpOnly guest cookie.

get.summary: List the authenticated shopper's saved products
get.description: Returns public catalog cards only, ordered by most recently saved.

put.summary: Save a public product to the authenticated shopper's wishlist
put.description: Idempotent: saving an already saved product succeeds without creating a duplicate.

delete.summary: Remove a product from the authenticated shopper's wishlist
delete.description: Idempotent: removing an absent product succeeds.

post.description: P0 supports COD. Card payments return 503 until a verified payment-provider integration is configured.

get.summary: Get tracking timeline and shipment details for an owned order
get.description: Returns order-level tracking even before dispatch; shipments is an empty array until tracking is available.

post.summary: Cancel an owned order before packing
post.description: Only placed and confirmed orders may be cancelled. Repeating a cancellation is idempotent. Inventory reservations are released in the same transaction; order and order items are retained.

get.summary: List the authenticated shopper's return requests

post.summary: Request a partial return for delivered order items
post.description: The order must be delivered and within 14 calendar days of deliveredAt. Return quantities are checked against prior non-rejected or non-cancelled requests. Creating a request does not issue a refund.

201.description: Return request created; no refund has been initiated

post.description: Only requested returns may be cancelled. Cancelled quantities become returnable again.
Reserved for verified provider confirmation. It currently returns 503 because card-provider integration has not been configured.

Language.name: lang
Language.description: Response language. Overrides Accept-Language when supplied.

VendorWorkspace.name: X-Vendor-Id
VendorWorkspace.description: Required when the authenticated account belongs to more than one vendor.

guestTokenAuth.name: X-Guest-Token
guestTokenAuth.description: Native guest JWT. Web clients authenticate their guest cart with the HttpOnly guest cookie instead.

MoneyAmount.description: Decimal money amount encoded as a string to avoid binary floating-point loss.

targetFilters.description: JSON object for a catalog target, e.g. {\"category\":\"women-dresses\",\"sort\":\"newest\"}.

image.description: JPEG, PNG, or WebP. The backend normalizes it to WebP and validates the selected section's ratio and minimum dimensions.

AdminHomePlacementUpdateRequest.description: All fields are optional. Provide a complete destination if targetType is changed; image is optional. Empty text clears an optional text field.

targetFilters.description: JSON object for a catalog target.

logo.description: JPEG, PNG, or WebP; optional, maximum 5 MiB.
JPEG, PNG, or WebP; logo-only updates are supported.

StrongPassword.description: Must contain a letter, number, and symbol; cannot contain adjacent repeated characters or three-character alphabetic/numeric sequences.

installationId.description: Required for android and ios clients.

oneOf.description: A valid intermediate authentication outcome, such as signup_required or account_exists.

refreshToken.description: Present for native clients; omitted for browser clients.

photoUrl.description: For S3-managed photos this is a short-lived signed URL. Refresh the profile when it expires.

refreshToken.description: Present for native clients; omitted for browser clients using the HttpOnly refresh cookie.

SelfBodyProfileUpsertRequest.description: Idempotently saves the current shopper's self profile. Relation is always self and must not be sent.

relation.description: Only partner, child, and other may be switched among one another. Changing into or out of self is rejected.

AuthOutcome.description: Authentication result or an intermediate next step

ResetToken.description: Password reset token created after OTP verification

AdminForbidden.description: The authenticated account lacks the required permission

AdminNotFound.description: The requested record was not found

AdminConflict.description: The operation conflicts with existing data or dependencies

AdminValidationError.description: The submitted fields or business rules are invalid

AdminPayloadTooLarge.description: The uploaded image exceeds the allowed size

Unauthorized.description: Access token missing, invalid, expired or revoked

Forbidden.description: Authenticated account cannot perform the operation

ReauthenticationRequired.description: The session is older than the sensitive-action window; log in again and retry

Conflict.description: The requested email or phone is already verified or belongs to another account

InvalidCredentials.description: Credentials or OTP are invalid or expired

Unprocessable.description: The request is syntactically valid but violates a business or image-validation rule

PayloadTooLarge.description: The profile photo exceeds the configured upload size

ProductNotFound.description: No public, approved product exists for the requested slug

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found

MediaNotFound.description: Media URL is invalid, expired, or the object does not exist

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a retry is allowed when supplied by the limiter.

InternalError.description: Storage or another backend dependency failed
